title: Physical goods (e-commerce), US
status: STARTER SET. Not legal advice. Platform and FTC rules change; review before live use.
sources: FTC Made in USA Labeling Rule (2021) and FTC enforcement sweeps 2025-2026
FTC Rule on the Use of Consumer Reviews and Testimonials (fake reviews and testimonials)

substantiation_patterns.note: Unqualified US-origin claims need substantiation (FTC Made in USA rule).

substantiation_patterns.regex: \b(american flag|us flag|u\.s\. flag|stars and stripes|map of the (usa|united states))\b
substantiation_patterns.note: Flag or map imagery can imply a US-origin claim.
Reviews and testimonials must be real and substantiated (FTC consumer review rule).
Superlatives and ranking claims need substantiation.
Efficacy and authority claims need substantiation.
Guarantee terms must match the actual offer terms.

knives_culinary.note: TikTok allows culinary knives only with 18+ targeting in listed markets (verify US). Meta allows culinary knives with 18+; avoid weapon-context language.

knives_non_culinary.note: Meta prohibits non-culinary knives and blades in ads. TikTok restricts utility knives to 18+ in listed markets (verify US).
